snippet.title: Crazy Chicken Pirates. Game for PS4 & PS5. Official English video.
snippet.description:
Ahoy, the pirates are coming!

An idyllic Caribbean island is infested with pirate chickens. Raid the island and try to capture their treasure. But the crazy chickens are by no means willing to just let you take their gold and diamonds without a fight. They defend their hideout with cannons and cutlasses, and bravely charge into the sea in their rowboats to launch a desperate counterattack. Be quick and fire from your arsenal for 90 seconds, preferably with the super cannon!
